name: Body Is A Temple
overview: Scripture teaches that our bodies are sacred, described as temples, notably in John 2:21 where Christ refers to the temple of His body. Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, reflecting a commitment to holiness and spiritual renewal as emphasized in Romans 12:1-2. This holiness extends to honoring our physical being by avoiding practices that defile the flesh, as commanded in Leviticus 19:28, and cherishing our bodies as the Lord cherishes the church, as expressed in Ephesians 5:29.
